name: Juuyon Banme no Xi
source:
"In Omega's azure gaze, you'll find 
The mirror of your truest mind." ᅳ Omega's Eyes (Sakutaro Hagiwara) 

Summer's almost here, but first, these middle school girls have to survive finals. Plus, there's a creepy story going around about a magic telephone pole that grants wishes if you win its deadly game. 


Sick of the rain and school, they just want summer. Then, one night, one of them sees something terrifying - a bloody figure. 

Suddenly, they're trapped in the game with the "Eight Sisters," a scary "Slayer," and the controlling "RULERS." A voice demands a body back... 

The game is brutal. Eat your friends' magical pets or be eaten. Only one can win. 

Jealousy, wishes... Let the games begin! 

"How deeply I wish that some fragments of these little stories
will, in the end, become your genuine nourishment." — Preface of The Restaurant of Many Orders (Kenji Miyazawa)
translation:
“在欧米茄蔚蓝的目光中，你会发现 
你最真实的心灵的镜子。” ᅳ 欧米茄之眼（萩原作太郎）夏天快到了，但首先，这些中学生必须在期末考试中幸存下来。另外，还有一个关于神奇电线杆的令人毛骨悚然的故事，如果你赢得了这场致命的游戏，它就会实现你的愿望。


他们厌倦了下雨和上学，只想要夏天。然后，一天晚上，其中一个人看到了一些可怕的东西——一个血淋淋的人影。

突然，他们被困在与“八姐妹”、可怕的“杀手”和控制者“统治者”的游戏中。一个声音要求身体回来…… 

游戏是残酷的。吃掉你朋友的魔法宠物或者被吃掉。只有一个人可以获胜。

嫉妒、愿望……比赛开始吧！

“我多么希望这些小故事的一些片段
最终，将成为你真正的滋养。” ——《点餐餐厅》序言（宫泽贤治）
